Reviewer, reviewee, assigner, and project manager use the same board.
Card visibility and actions remain backend-authorized.

Privacy determines cards, not a separate interface.
Completed items stay on the board via filters.

boards.purpose: Post-sprint review of project and work environment.
acceptance: There is no standalone environment-review history page.
